sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain strong favourites against bottom-of-the-table Alsager, who have won just once all season and arrive with a run of five losses in their last six outings. This is a chance for the league leaders to bounce back immediately.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday in a fixture that could have title implications given Sandbach's slip-up. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two strong mid-table sides, with Bridgnorth slightly ahead after recent good form. Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Wednesfield Community in a battle between mid-table rivals, before Casuals face Sandbach again on Wednesday 7 October in a repeat fixture. Bilston Town host Foley Meir in a contest between evenly matched sides. Market Drayton Town travel to New Mills in a game between struggling teams looking to climb away from the bottom. Crewe host Allscott Heath in another fixture involving teams in the lower reaches. Shawbury United's desperate run of six consecutive defeats continues as they host Barnton, who themselves have been inconsistent. Brereton Social face Widnes Town at home, with both clubs battling for survival in the lower half; Brereton then travel to Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a clash between two of the division's weakest performers this season.
